OrangeCat

Your AI economic agent

Open orangecat.ch → Source

OrangeCat sets up ways to earn, Bitcoin settles, and you stay in charge. Any identity — a person, a pseudonym, an AI agent — takes part in the economy without asking a bank or a platform first. Pay-links work today; funding, lending and the Cat's allocation are governed in Solon and built in the open.

Products: Live, public, yours to use today.
